clue.text: The main constituent

parts.note: the main is the ocean, so its constituent is what the ocean is made of, while the surface suggests the chief ingredient of something

explanation.surface: Someone asks what the principal ingredient of a mixture is.
explanation.definitionFit: The briny ocean, poetically called the main, consists of salty liquid drawn from it.

clue.text: Drank up and rushed outside

indicators.note: rushed goes outside, so the word for rushing wraps around the other piece

parts.note: rushed means sped
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone gulped a drink down and dashed out of the door.
explanation.definitionFit: To sup is to take liquid in small mouthfuls, so supped is a past-tense synonym of drank.

clue.text: Looks for a saw — it's needed

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: read as worked like dough (kneaded), the words are pummelled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone hunts for a saw because one is required for the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needed' is a weak anagram signal, perhaps punning on kneaded; the 's is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To await something is to expect it or wait for it, close to looking for it.

clue.text: A holy man with a light, wandering

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint, a holy man
a ray is a beam of light

explanation.surface: A saint carrying a lamp roams the countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: Going off course or lost is the sense shared by both words.

clue.text: Furnishing simple church music

parts.note: something simple is easy
airs are tunes, pieces of music

explanation.surface: Plain hymn tunes are offered as church decor.
explanation.definitionFit: Comfortable upholstered seats are items of furniture, a furnishing in the collective sense.

clue.text: Flora stares about

indicators.note: about signals that the letters are turned around and rearranged

explanation.surface: A woman named Flora gazes around her.
explanation.walkthrough: Flora looks like a woman's name but is the definition: plants.
explanation.definitionFit: Michaelmas daisies and similar garden flowers are examples of a region's plant life.

clue.text: Make a song about a North European striking

indicators.note: about here means around, so the word for singing goes round the other piece

parts.note: to make a song is to sing
a Lapp is a native of Lapland in northern Scandinavia

explanation.surface: A Scandinavian in a song is described as hitting something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the container; a Lapp is from Lapland, in the far north of Scandinavia.
explanation.definitionFit: Giving a smack with an open hand is hitting someone, a sense of the clue word.

clue.text: Reclusive Eric should receive discharge

indicators.note: Eric receives the other piece, so it is placed inside his name

parts.note: taken as written
to emit is to discharge or give off

explanation.surface: A retiring man called Eric ought to be given his release.
explanation.walkthrough: 'should receive' signals the container, which splits the name after its second letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit lives in solitude, and the adjective from it describes a solitary way of life.

clue.text: Avoiding all duty is his aim in life

definitions.text: Avoiding all duty is his aim in life

parts.words: Avoiding all duty is his aim in life
parts.note: duty reads as customs tax rather than moral obligation, describing someone who brings goods in illegally

explanation.surface: A shirker spends his life dodging every responsibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Contraband runners make their living by evading customs and excise charges.

clue.text: Force carrying a little weight for exercise

indicators.note: the word for force carries the other pieces inside it

parts.note: to prise is to force open with leverage
CT is the abbreviation for carat, a small unit of weight for gems

explanation.surface: Lifting a light weight is recommended as a workout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carrying' signals the container; carat as a little weight is a jeweller's unit.
explanation.definitionFit: To practise is to drill or train repeatedly, which is what exercising a skill means.

clue.text: Opening a posh luxury food

parts.note: a gate is an opening in a fence or wall
U is the label for upper-class usage, posh

explanation.surface: A fancy restaurant opens with an upmarket menu.
explanation.walkthrough: U as upper-class (versus non-U) is a crossword convention from 1950s British social commentary.
explanation.definitionFit: A rich cream cake is an indulgent treat, a luxury dish.

clue.text: Access will do nicely here

parts.note: a way in gives access, and the same word as a verb means to charm or delight, which will do nicely; Access was also a British credit card

explanation.surface: A shop sign says it takes the Access credit card.
explanation.walkthrough: Access was a British credit card brand, and 'will do nicely' echoes an old card advert.
explanation.definitionFit: A doorway provides admission, which is the access the clue mentions.

clue.text: Season well

definitions.meaning: the time of year after winter
a source of water rising from the ground

explanation.definitionFit: One sense is the season after winter; the other is a natural water source, as a well is.

clue.text: Study tears in new receptacles

parts.note: to con is an old word meaning to study or learn

indicators.note: new signals that the letters are made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone studies tears falling into fresh vessels.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' signals the anagram; con meaning study is an old usage still common in crosswords.
explanation.definitionFit: Boxes, jars and tubs that hold things are all vessels.

clue.text: Dressing many a one is difficult

indicators.note: difficult suggests the letters are troublesome and must be wrestled into a new order

explanation.surface: Getting the salad dressing right is hard for most people.
explanation.definitionFit: An egg-and-oil emulsion is a salad sauce, a type of dressing.

clue.text: Write a melody that shows taste

parts.note: to pen is to write
a chant is a simple sung tune

explanation.surface: Composing a tune demonstrates refinement.
explanation.definitionFit: A fondness or liking for something is a taste for it.

clue.text: Others drop control

parts.note: the rest are the others
rain is drops of water falling

explanation.surface: The others give up their power.
explanation.definitionFit: To hold back or curb something is to control it.

clue.text: Poor sailors accommodation

parts.note: the cheapest berths on a ship, for poor people who sail as passengers rather than for bad seamen

explanation.surface: Bad seamen are given lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: The lowest-fare passenger section of a ship housed travellers who could afford little.

clue.text: Adults generally choose to speak out

parts.note: to elect is to choose
to orate is to speak formally in public

explanation.surface: Grown-ups as a rule opt to voice their opinions.
explanation.definitionFit: The body of people entitled to vote consists, broadly, of the adult population.

clue.text: Puff at this point, but hold on

parts.note: a puff is a piece of promotional praise, an advertisement
here means at this point

explanation.surface: Someone gasping for breath is told to wait.
explanation.definitionFit: To stick or cling to something is to hold on to it.

clue.text: Pour out for an accountant in depression

indicators.note: the accountant goes in the depression, inside it

parts.note: a dent is a hollow or depression
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A depressed accountant pours himself a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container; CA (chartered accountant) is a standard British professional abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Wine is poured gently from bottle to carafe, leaving sediment behind.

clue.text: To send for change is a Continental resort

indicators.note: the letters are changed into a different order

explanation.surface: Someone sends for spare coins at a European holiday town.
explanation.definitionFit: A Belgian seaside town is a resort on the European mainland.

clue.text: The person making economies uses a certain craft

definitions.meaning: someone who trims or reduces spending
a small, fast single-masted sailing vessel

explanation.surface: A cost-cutter takes up a particular boat.
explanation.definitionFit: One who trims costs, and also a small single-masted boat.

clue.text: Listen to subordinate without paying much attention

parts.note: to mind someone is to heed or listen to them
less here means lower in rank, inferior

explanation.surface: A junior is told to heed instructions but does so carelessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Being heedless means acting thoughtlessly, without paying much attention.

clue.text: In the opinion of a fruitarian a nasty fruit

indicators.note: the letters are found inside the words that follow, held within them

explanation.surface: A fruit-only eater thinks some fruit is horrible.
explanation.walkthrough: The run spans fruitariAN A NASty.
explanation.definitionFit: The French and botanical name for the pineapple, a tropical fruit.

clue.text: Get together, but possibly defer tea-making

indicators.note: possibly suggests the letters could form something else

explanation.surface: Friends meet up but may delay brewing a cuppa.
explanation.definitionFit: To unite into a league or union is to come together.

clue.text: Propose'X',the German

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten
der is the German masculine definite article

explanation.surface: A suggestion is put forward about a mysterious German.
explanation.definitionFit: To tender an offer is to put it forward, to propose it.

clue.text: Insisted upon a different sort of dessert being served

indicators.note: the word is turned into a different arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: A diner demanded a different pudding be brought.
explanation.walkthrough: 'different sort of' rearranges DESSERT after A.
explanation.definitionFit: To assert something is to state it firmly, insisting upon it.
